turns.content: Good news, the ClickHouse migration shipped and I got promoted to senior data engineer!
That's great news, congratulations! Did the cost projections hold up?
Mostly. We're at about 40% savings, Priya is happy. In other news I signed up for the Austin half marathon in October. Training starts next week.
Nice goal. Have you run one before?
Never. Longest I've done is 10k. My sister Nora is flying in to run it with me, she's done three.
